$description: Tier 2 · Semantic roles. Emitted as --* (no prefix): the shadcn/ui contract plus the sidebar contract. `$value` is light mode; `$extensions["unicron.modes"].dark` is dark mode. Apps add their own roles in an extension layer (see examples/app-extension.css), never here.

unicron.theme.$description: Extra entries for the Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` block. Radius steps are multiples of --radius.

support-foreground.$description: Support text: the lines that explain, under a title or beside a value (descriptions, an empty state's text). Emphasis Engine's text level 4, between primary text (level 5, --foreground) and secondary text (level 3, --muted-foreground), at least Lc 10 from each on every page surface coded, and 12 as drawn (scripts/contrast.mjs; apps check the drawn side). Strong enough for every fill as it is.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text, drawn small: labels, meta (when, how many), captions, overlines, placeholders, inactive tabs, keys. Emphasis Engine's text level 3, a level below primary text (level 5): APCA Lc 75 (Bronze, under 16px) on every page surface it reads on, in each mode, and at least Lc 20 under primary text on the same surface (scripts/contrast.mjs). Inside a fill, it's re-pointed at --muted-foreground-on-fill (@unicron/ui's styles).

muted-foreground-on-fill.$description: Secondary text on a fill (bg-muted, bg-accent, bg-secondary, a highlighted or selected item, a key): a shade stronger in light mode so it still reads Lc 75 there (Lc 77 on neutral.100). A fill re-points --muted-foreground at it for its own content, so components and apps keep writing text-muted-foreground. Dark mode needs no shift: neutral.250 clears every dark fill.

destructive.$description: Destructive text, and the tint behind destructive labels (bg-destructive/10, /20). Solved as a readable red: Lc 75 as text on the page, a card and a selected row; Lc 60 as a label on its own tint (scripts/contrast.mjs).

warning.$description: A warning fill under --warning-foreground: the label Lc 60 or more, and the fill Lc 30 or more against the page, the sidebar and a selected row, in each mode.

info.$description: An info fill under --info-foreground: white on blue.500 in both modes, Lc 72.

input.$description: Control borders (fields, selects, checkboxes, the off switch) and, at 30-80%, the dark field and switch fills. 3:1 on every surface it borders (WCAG 1.4.11), so a field can be found.

ring.$description: Focus ring. The primitives draw it at 50% (ring-ring/50, outline-ring/50), so the step is dark enough that the half-strength ring still clears APCA Lc 30 on every surface (scripts/contrast.mjs).

motion-fast.$description: Small state changes and entrances: a hover, a press, a dialog or menu appearing. 120ms, the floor below which a change reads as a jump. Tailwind's default transition duration (`transition`, `transition-colors`) is mapped to it.

motion-base.$description: Larger moves: a sheet sliding in, a toast entering or leaving.

motion-ease.$description: The one curve: fast out, gentle settle. Tailwind's default transition curve and `ease-standard` are mapped to it.
